title: Duplicated quote-ID truncation with inconsistent threshold and ellipsis glyph
description: The same 'truncate the current quote id for display' behaviour is hand-rolled twice with different limits and different ellipsis characters: the nav header truncates at length > 12 to slice(0,10) + ASCII '...', while the sidebar truncates at length > 14 to slice(0,12) + Unicode '…'. A single shared helper (e.g. truncateMiddle/truncateEnd(id, n)) would remove the duplication and the visual inconsistency where the two displays of one id can disagree on whether/how it is shortened.
evidence: Line 599: {currentQuoteId.length > 12 ? currentQuoteId.slice(0, 10) + "..." : currentQuoteId}. Lines 716-718: {currentQuoteId.length > 14 ? currentQuoteId.slice(0, 12) + "…" : currentQuoteId}. Different cutoff (12 vs 14), different prefix length (10 vs 12), different ellipsis ('...' vs '…').
behavior_preservation: Behaviour-preserving only if both call sites are unified to one rule; choosing one threshold/glyph is a deliberate, tiny visual normalisation.
